title: Smart Data Models - SunSpec Information Models - DERMeasureAC
description: DER AC Measurement. DER AC measurement model. SunSpec Information Model 701 (DERMeasureAC), sunspec/models v2026-04-20. Point names kept verbatim; values are given already scaled, so the scale-factor (*_SF), padding and model framing (ID, L) points are left out.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:DERMeasureAC:<Mn>-<SN> (manufacturer and serial number of the device).

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DERMeasureAC'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

refCommon.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. The `common` entity (SunSpec model 1: manufacturer, model, serial number) of the device that exposes this SunSpec model. Not a SunSpec point (Smart Data Models addition): in SunSpec all models of a device are read from the same Modbus map, whose first model is always model 1.

dateObserved.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time when the values of this SunSpec model were read from the device. Not a SunSpec point (Smart Data Models addition): SunSpec models carry no timestamp.

ACType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_701.json#ACType'. AC Wiring Type. Values are the SunSpec symbol names (SINGLE_PHASE=0, SPLIT_PHASE=1, THREE_PHASE=2). SunSpec type enum16. Mandatory in SunSpec.

St.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_701.json#St'. Operating State. Operating state of the DER. Values are the SunSpec symbol names (OFF=0, ON=1). SunSpec type enum16. Standards: IEEE 1547-2018.

InvSt.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_701.json#InvSt'. Inverter State. Values are the SunSpec symbol names (OFF=0, SLEEPING=1, STARTING=2, RUNNING=3, THROTTLED=4, SHUTTING_DOWN=5, FAULT=6, STANDBY=7). SunSpec type enum16.

ConnSt.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_701.json#ConnSt'. Grid Connection State. Grid connection state of the DER. Values are the SunSpec symbol names (DISCONNECTED=0, CONNECTED=1). SunSpec type enum16. Standards: IEEE 1547-2018.

Alrm.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_701.json#Alrm'. Alarm Bitfield. Active alarms for the DER. Bitfield: the array lists the names of the bits that are set (GROUND_FAULT=bit 0, DC_OVER_VOLT=bit 1, AC_DISCONNECT=bit 2, DC_DISCONNECT=bit 3, GRID_DISCONNECT=bit 4, CABINET_OPEN=bit 5, MANUAL_SHUTDOWN=bit 6, OVER_TEMP=bit 7, OVER_FREQUENCY=bit 8, UNDER_FREQUENCY=bit 9, AC_OVER_VOLT=bit 10, AC_UNDER_VOLT=bit 11, BLOWN_STRING_FUSE=bit 12, UNDER_TEMP=bit 13, MEMORY_LOSS=bit 14, HW_TEST_FAILURE=bit 15, MANUFACTURER_ALRM=bit 16); an empty array means no bit set. SunSpec type bitfield32. Standards: IEEE 1547-2018.

DERMode.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_701.json#DERMode'. DER Operational Characteristics. Current operational characteristics of the DER.
